content_sections.heading: About IIITD
content_sections.text: IIITD is the Indraprastha Institute of Information Technology Delhi, a State University established by an Act of the Govt. of NCT of Delhi (IIIT-Delhi Act 2007). The notice is signed by the Registrar. The post sits in the Placements Division and works with the Head Career Services and the placement and student teams.

content_sections.heading: Vacancy and Who Can Apply
content_sections.text: The notice lists one post, Deputy Administrative Officer, under post code Recruitment/42/2026-01, in the UR category. Post Graduate degree in the relevant domain with good academic record (minimum 55% marks); or Equivalent and total 8 years of relevant experience out of which 6 years at Level-6; or Equivalent experience for those working in private organizations. Minimum of 4 to 5 years of relevant work experience in campus placement in an educational/research institutes/University, AND Established network and live connections with the industry. The prescribed qualifications are minimum; possessing them does not entitle a candidate to be called for the selection process. Candidates should check the official notification for the full eligibility rules.

content_sections.heading: Pay and Tenure
content_sections.text: The post carries Level-8 (Rs. 47600 – Rs.151100) as per 7th CPC. The notice says the position is associated with House Rent Allowance (HRA), Dearness Allowance (DA), Travel Allowance (TA), Medical Allowance, National Pension System (NPS), mobile expenses reimbursement, data card reimbursement, LTS reimbursement, Professional Development Allowance (PDA), Group Term Insurance, Group Health Insurance, Children's Education Allowance and NPL Bonus. Deserving candidates may be given higher starting salary, additional increments or pay protection. The notice states that all posts are contractual, initially for five years or as recommended by the Selection Committee, extendable as per Institute norms and the provisions of the Recruitment and Promotion Rules for Non-Teaching Staff – 2024.

content_sections.heading: IIITD Deputy Administrative Officer Job Description
content_sections.text: The notice lists these key responsibilities and desirable skills: Invite companies to participate in campus placements and internships for all pre-final, final year UG, PG students. Minimum of 20 new recruiters for final placement for both A and A+ category with a minimum compensation of 8 lacs, 7 above 15 to 20 summer and 6 months internship opportunities for final and pre-final year students of all UG and PG programs in one season. Achieve individual targets assigned for the annual recruitment and internships process. Track and maintain placement and internship database, collecting feedback from all recruiters, all documentation, record keeping, filing, maintaining student tracker, institute calendar etc. Leverage social media platforms for collecting relevant job opportunities, to network with employers of various designations of companies. Assist Head Career Services to create brochures, manuals. Assist Head Career Services to update the content on IIIT-D's placement website and ensure that it is complete, current, relevant, and accurate. Assist in conducting Mock test, Mock Interviews, Sessions and Start-Up Fair, any important visits and allied task. Work closely with the Placement Team and student team. Ability to work with other departments in a cordial professional manner for smooth execution of placements. Contribute towards any other task assigned by the department/University from time to time. Excellent oral and written communication skills in English.

content_sections.heading: How to Apply for IIITD Deputy Administrative Officer
content_sections.text: Apply online on the IIITD recruitment portal at https://iiitd.nurecampus.com/NURE/OnlineRecruitmentApplication.action . The form can be filled from 17 November 2026. Submit the application by 7 December 2026, 5 PM. Pay the application fee of INR 590 unless you are in an exempted category. Incomplete applications or those whose fees are not paid will be summarily rejected. Candidates working in Govt. Organization/Autonomous Bodies/PSUs etc. will be required to produce the No Objection Certificate and (if applicable) Vigilance Clearance through proper channel. Internal candidates must inform the HR division and the Head of the Division when applying. For queries about the recruitment portal process, email [email protected] .

content_sections.text: The application fee of those not shortlisted will not be refunded.

content_sections.heading: Selection and Interview
content_sections.text: Applications are scrutinised for eligibility by a Screening Committee constituted by the Competent Authority. If the number of applications is very large, the Institute can devise additional shortlisting criteria or use higher eligibility/experience. Provisionally shortlisted applicants will be called for further selection process, as determined by the Competent Authority. Shortlisted candidates will be informed through the e-mails mentioned in the application form only. The notice does not describe the later stages, their dates or any venue.

faq.question: Q1. How many vacancies are there in IIITD Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: There is 1 vacancy, for the post of Deputy Administrative Officer (Placements) in the Placements Division, in the UR category.

faq.question: Q2. What is the last date to apply for the IIITD Deputy Administrative Officer post?
faq.answer: The last date for applying online is 7 December 2026 by 5 PM. The form can be filled from 17 November 2026.

faq.question: Q3. What is the qualification for IIITD Deputy Administrative Officer?
faq.answer: A Post Graduate degree in the relevant domain with good academic record (minimum 55% marks), or equivalent and total 8 years of relevant experience out of which 6 years at Level-6, or equivalent experience for those working in private organizations.

faq.question: Q4. What is the salary of IIITD Deputy Administrative Officer?
faq.answer: The post is at Level-8 (Rs. 47600 – Rs.151100) as per 7th CPC.

faq.question: Q5. What is the application fee?
faq.answer: The fee is a non-refundable INR 590 for each advertised post. SC, ST, PwD and women candidates, and internal candidates including allied staff, are exempted.

faq.question: Q6. How can I apply for IIITD Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Apply online at https://iiitd.nurecampus.com/NURE/OnlineRecruitmentApplication.action by 7 December 2026, 5 PM. Incomplete applications or those whose fees are not paid will be summarily rejected.

faq.question: Q7. How will candidates be selected?
faq.answer: A Screening Committee scrutinises applications for eligibility, and provisionally shortlisted applicants are called for further selection process as determined by the Competent Authority. Shortlisted candidates are informed by e-mail.

faq.question: Q8. Is the IIITD Deputy Administrative Officer post permanent?
faq.answer: No, the notice states that all posts are contractual, initially for five years or as recommended by the Selection Committee, extendable as per Institute norms.

faq.question: Q9. Do HRA and other allowances come with the post?
faq.answer: The notice says the position is associated with benefits including HRA, DA, TA, Medical Allowance, NPS, Group Term Insurance, Group Health Insurance, Children's Education Allowance and NPL Bonus.

faq.question: Q10. Is there age relaxation for IIITD employees?
faq.answer: Yes, Institute employees (including outsourced staff and employees working in Centers, Section-8 companies, etc.) get age relaxation of up to five years or the serving period, whichever is less. Other relaxation is as per Government of India norms.
